items.title: Unlawful excavation of river cliff disturbs Aboriginal ancestral remains
items.description: A cliff site in South Australia's Riverland, home to Aboriginal ancestral remains, has been excavated without authorisation.

items.title: Boy charged with murdering mother, attempting to kill sister in Perth
items.description: A 16-year-old boy is charged with murdering his mother and attempting to kill his sister in an alleged domestic violence homicide in suburban Perth.

items.title: NT enacts 'significant overhaul' of child protection system
items.description: The Northern Territory parliament has passed changes to child protection laws, with the Country Liberal Party describing its amendments as "the most significant overhaul of the Territory's child protection system in a generation".

items.title: Concerns raised over AusAlert emergency warning system
items.description: State and territory representatives had voiced concerns about the rollout of the national emergency warning system in a meeting with the minister Kristy McBain.

items.title: Live: Taylor calls on Labor to stop ISIS doctor from returning home
items.description: Angus Taylor has called on the government to stop an ISIS-linked Australian doctor from returning home. Follow live.

items.title: Woman's family wrongly told she was dead in hospital identity error
items.description: A Melbourne hospital apologises after mixing up the medical data of two people, resulting in one of them being wrongly declared dead by police.

items.title: 'We do not want to highlight this yet': AI data centre's FAQ slip-up
items.description: Data centre builder Firmus posted a statement, since removed, indicating its intention to get some of its cooling water from the state-owned irrigation system, adding "but we do not want to highlight this yet".

items.title: Albanese's career mirrors Howard's in two important ways
items.description: Anthony Albanese has been in near-fatal vehicle accidents not once, but three times. Politically, his is also a story of survival against the odds.

items.title: Gas tax, gambling and AI at stake at the Labor conference
items.description: Labor members and unions are gearing up for fights over gambling, gas and AI at the party's national conference later this week.

items.title: Family's cross-contamination nightmare after contractors spread mould
items.description: A Queensland family is living in an overcrowded caravan and shed after insurance provider Suncorp exacerbated damage in their home, initially caused by a leak.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
